prw — coming forth, appearance, a god's going out in procession (noun m.; from pri 'go forth') — prw·f (w3)
šwt — feather, plume (noun f.; dual šwty 'the two plumes' of a crown, as Min's; Budge: śuti) — šwty·f (w6, w24, w58)
ḏrt — kite, the bird of prey; ḏrty 'the two kites', Isis and Nephthys as mourners of Osiris (noun f.; Budge: t'ertutu, 'protectresses') — ḏrtw (w38)
sꜣk — to gather, draw together, collect (verb; reading not sure; Budge: sàka, 'provide') — sꜣk·sn (w39)
irt — eye (noun f.; dual irty 'the two eyes') — irty·f (w56)
iwt — wrong, misdeed, evil (noun f.; Budge: āut, 'failings') — iwt·i (w85)
ḫsr — to drive away, dispel (evil, wrongs) (verb; Budge: χersek) — ḫsr·i (w86)
šꜥd — to cut, cut off (verb; infinitive šꜥd 'a cutting'; cf. šꜥt 'slaughter') — šꜥd·tw (w92), šꜥd (w294)
ẖpꜣ — navel, navel cord (noun m.; Budge: χapaa, 'the corruptible matter') — ẖpꜣ (w93)
sḥri — to remove, drive away, put far off (verb; causative of ḥri 'be far') — sḥri·tw (w103)
wꜣḏ-wr — 'the Great Green', the sea or a great body of water; also the name of a water in the world below (place name; Budge: Uat'-urà, 'Green Lake') — wꜣḏ-wr (w144+145, w165+166, w177+178)
ḥsmn — natron, the salt used for cleansing and purifying (noun m.; Budge: ḥesmen) — ḥsmn (w152)
mꜥꜣt — a substance or place named beside natron, not identified (noun f.; not Maat; Budge: Māāāat, 'nitre'; reading and sense uncertain) — mꜥꜣt (w157)
š-mꜣꜥt — 'the Lake of Maat', a lake of Abydos in the world below (place name; Budge: Śe-Maāat) — š-mꜣꜥt (w197, w216)
kꜣri — shrine, chapel (noun m.; Budge: kerà) — kꜣri (w238)
ḏsr — holy, sacred, set apart (adjective; verb 'be holy, set apart'; Budge: sert, as in tꜣ-ḏsr, Ta-sert) — ḏsrt (w243)
bꜣḥ — presence (noun; m-bꜣḥ 'in the presence of'; imyw-bꜣḥ 'those who are in the presence', the gods before the creator; Budge: baḥ) — imyw-bꜣḥ (w270)
snf — blood (noun m.) — snf (w283)
wꜣi — to set out, start on (a road); wꜣ r with an infinitive 'set about, begin to' (verb; written with the lasso wꜣ and the road; Budge: ua) — wꜣ·f (w291)
ḥw — Hu, the god of the commanding word, the creator's utterance (god's name; Budge: Ḥu) — ḥw (w303)
mḥ — to fill, fill up (verb; mḥ wḏꜣt 'fill the Eye', make it whole) — mḥ·n·i (w316)
hꜣb — a verb of harm or loss said of the Eye, not otherwise known in this sense (verb; Budge: hab, 'had failed'; reading and meaning uncertain) — hꜣb·s (w324)
rḥwy — the Two Companions, Horus and Seth (dual noun, from rḥ 'companion'; Budge: Reḥu, 'the two Fighters') — rḥwy (w329)
ẖrwy — testicles (dual noun; Budge: χerui) — ẖrwy (w350)
ḏbꜥ — finger (noun m.; plural ḏbꜥw) — ḏbꜥw·f (w359)
nšny — storm, raging (noun; from nšn 'rage'; Budge: neśeni, 'storms') — nšny (w367)
BROADEN nḏ — nḏ-ḥr, 'protect, care for', literally 'look after the face of' (compound with ḥr 'face'; participle nḏ-ḥr itf·f 'who protects his father', a name of Horus) — nḏ-ḥr (w17)
BROADEN mn — a second word of the same spelling: to suffer, be ill; ailment, suffering (verb, noun; written with the bird of bad things) — mn (w41)
BROADEN sš — a further word of the same spelling: nest (noun m.; written with the nest of young birds; dual sšwy) — sšwy·i (w119)
BROADEN šn — a second word of the same spelling: hair (noun; written with the cord šn and the lock of hair; Budge: śen) — šn (w363)
BROADEN ·w — also the 3rd person plural 'they' of later Egyptian, written w (after ꜥḥꜥ·n) — ꜥḥꜥ·n·w (w297)
BROADEN ꜥḥꜥ — also ꜥḥꜥ·n 'then', the auxiliary that opens a narrative sentence — ꜥḥꜥ·n·w (w297)
BROADEN gr — the particle grt apparently also written ẖrt, with the sign ẖr, after ir and in (reading not sure) — ẖrt (w183, w215, w240, w354)
BROADEN wꜥb — also wꜥb 'purification, purity' (noun) — wꜥb (w111)
BROADEN m — also written mꜥ, with the arm, in later copies — mꜥ (w309)
BROADEN stꜣt — also written stw, without ꜣ — stw (w344)
BROADEN pwy — also standing for pw 'it is' in a sentence without a verb — pwy (w335)
BROADEN ẖrt — ẖrt hrw 'the daily round, what belongs to the day' — ẖrt (w310)
